title_hi: रूमिनेशन: studies वास्तव में क्या मापते हैं?
unique_angle: Trait questionnaires, momentary smartphone sampling, content-versus-process items, and different scales sample different windows of rumination; no single score is a complete record of private thought.
evidence_class: peer-reviewed rumination methods study + experience-sampling instrument study + questionnaire-comparison methods study
